extDescription.message: Control video speed and quality in Chrome from Stream Deck, OpenDeck, TourBox or an Xbox controller. Talks only to this computer.

companionNote.message: VJster needs one free program on this computer: Fadester for OBS or the VJster plugin (for Stream Deck or OpenDeck), or Fadester Companion. Alone, this extension does nothing.

portNote.message: The port VJster uses in Fadester for OBS, the VJster plugin or Fadester Companion, on this computer only. Change it only if you changed it there.

idNote.message: To let only this extension connect, paste the id into the VJster settings of Fadester for OBS, the VJster plugin or Fadester Companion.

allSites.message: Control videos on every site, not only YouTube

allSitesNote.message: Speed only: quality needs YouTube's player. Untick to keep VJster on YouTube only.

hotkeysNote.message: [ slower, ] faster, \ back to 1×. Off until you turn it on. Ignored while you type in a text box. Works without a Stream Deck or any other program.

statusLinkDown.message: Not connected. Check the program you use:

statusFirstWait.message: Waiting for VJster. Do one of these:

statusStandby.message: Standing by. Another copy of this extension (another Chrome profile or browser) holds the link; this one takes over when that one closes.

linkDownCompanion.message: Fadester Companion: open it on this computer and check that its controls are on.

linkDownDeck.message: Stream Deck or OpenDeck: show a page with a VJster key or dial, or tick “Keep the link on” in the VJster settings.

linkDownPort.message: The port here must be the same as in that program’s VJster settings.

reloadTabsNote.message: Video tabs that were open before VJster was installed or updated: reload them once.

statusBadPort.message: Use a whole number from 1024 to 65535; $DEFAULT$ is the default.

statusSaved.message: Saved. VJster now connects to port $PORT$.

statusNotAllowed.message: Not allowed: VJster stays on YouTube only.

statusAllSites.message: VJster now controls videos on every site. Reload open tabs to include them.

statusYouTubeOnly.message: VJster is back to YouTube only.

statusYouTubeOnlyKept.message: VJster is back to YouTube only; Chrome kept the all-sites permission, remove it on the extension's details page.

tabThis.message: VJster controls the video in this tab.

tabThisPinned.message: VJster is pinned to this tab.

tabOther.message: VJster controls a video in another tab.

tabOtherPinned.message: VJster is pinned to another tab.

tabNone.message: No tab with a video yet. Open a YouTube video.
